notes.title: Resolution adjustment option
notes.notes:
Added option to pick which resolution you can have the game at. Default and recommended is 1920 x 1080.

Anything below 800 x 600 turns the game into pixel soup and you need to pick the correct aspect ratio to avoid getting the automatic letterboxing effect.

More to come :)

notes.title: Regional pricing
notes.notes:
Hey all,
This post is to get a feel for how the game has been priced.
Coming up to the release I decided to use Steams own recommended price points for all currencies. While this made the process simple, I know that this approach has its drawbacks. Mainly since the game is only design for one language, those who are buying the game with English as a second language are not receiving the same experience. Also any post launch support non-native English speaking player receive will also be at a disadvantage. There is also the fact that the currency conversions will never truly reflect the economic situation that they are based in. The game is designed to be a cheap fun experience, if the games costs too much, that needs to change.

To account for this, I want to adjust the regional pricing to more accurately account for imbalances in experience. 

Below is a link to the Steam Data Base website, displaying the information on 'Supreme Power'. Here you can see how the game is priced compared to each currency available to be used on Steam:

https://steamdb.info/app/3354170/

(The percentages in the middle show the percentage difference to the British Pound, which is the primary price)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45365979/bae1195e734c7c364799daf96eaf992dba512c11.png[/img]

The point of this post is, if the game cost is unusually or unreasonable more then you would expect for a currency, then do leave a comment suggesting what changes could be made.

Cheers

notes.title: Bug fixes and load layout feature
notes.notes:
Small patch:
-Fixed "New Game" Steam achievement not being earnable, starting or continuing a game will grant this
-Fixed missing tech reward Icon for 'Ceramic plates'

Feature added:
-Ability to reuse a previous layout when adding new Combat Sections. Should speed up the process so you don't have to reapply new equipment every time.

notes.title: Welcome!
notes.notes:
Its great to see people enjoying the game so far.

My priority as the developer at the moment is the create a guide / tutorial for the game, so expect that to be done by the start of next week.

There is also additional content being worked on for the game, which will be added I the near future so stay tuned for that.

So far no major bugs or game breaking behaviour has been reported. If they happen, do let me know immediately if this happens so I can get a fix implemented quickly.

Otherwise I am humbled by your support and look forward to seeing how everyone is getting on.

Cheers.
